answer: Locks are written down in garden, expire in pigment, and horizon lists each expiry. An farming party running 60 aliases as a result needs 85 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 87 dollars in locked collateral and another 7 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
